notes: The presentative frame 'And it came to pass ... that' is one discontinuous unit on וַיְהִי, with the date phrases standing inside it (rules 21, 45).

שְׁתֵּי עֶשְׂרֵה is one English word, so the two numeral morphemes share a unit under rule 30; the 'the' of 'the twelfth year' goes to שָׁנָה as the nominal expression's head noun, with the competing attachment named.
